data.name: Murtaza
data.gender_notes: Murtaza is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ر-ض-ي (r-ḍ-y), 'to be pleased'. Murtiḍā means 'chosen, approved'. Its root is ر-ض-ي (r-ḍ-y). An epithet of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib. Murtaza is a Arabic name meaning “Chosen; approved; content”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Murtaza expresses “Chosen; approved; content”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murtaza total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
